scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:secrets

CREDENTIALS_KV.description: Stores the encrypted CPA credential and refreshed OAuth tokens. Cloudflare creates and binds a private KV namespace automatically.

CLIENT_API_KEY.description: Set a strong random key that clients must send as a Bearer token when calling /v1/* routes.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Set a different strong random key for credential import and other /admin/* routes.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Set a unique random value of at least 32 characters. It encrypts CPA credentials before they are stored in KV.
